findings.file: .github/workflows/ci.yml:~895 (step 'The report is interactive on plans cut from the scale demo', P126.15-13q, b582f550); tools/gate-parity.py STEP_GUARD_EXEMPT
findings.issue: The split step carries no `if:`, so it runs only under the default success(): it is skipped after ANY earlier failed step of the manifests job (screenshots, GIF, vitest, the guarded interactive step), not only after a failed `Scale demo`. The exemption reason and the step's own comment justify it by the one dependency (/tmp/dl), but the behaviour is broader than that dependency, so the one-status, all-parked and no-proposals legs stay hidden behind unrelated failures - the class P126.10-13q set out to remove, now confined to these legs. step_exemption_breadth_drift checks that the step reads the named path and that an earlier step mentions it; it cannot see this, and its own docstring says so.
findings.resolution: Give the Scale demo step an `id:` and the split step `if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.<id>.outcome == 'success' }}`, so it is skipped only when its producer failed. Then the STEP_GUARD_EXEMPT row can say so, or be dropped if step_guard_drift is taught to accept an outcome condition naming an earlier step.

intent.note: Phase outcome: CI on the 3.3.0 candidate green on ubuntu, macOS and windows with no check weakened. Evidence: CI run 38324787932 on ci/p126 at 0aca587b (P126.13) is green on all five jobs including windows-latest. That run PRECEDES the four fix tasks reviewed here (P126.14 to P126.17), so their Windows behaviour is not yet CI-observed; they change the red-first helper's line-end reading, ci.yml step structure, a machine-path spelling guard and one test case, and the sweep must be re-run on the head. Re-judgement of P126.3 in light of P126.14: P126.3's own commit read the working file with newline='' while the HEAD blob stayed as git printed it, which broke the LF-blob/CRLF-working-file checkout (autocrlf=true) - that was the earlier 'diverges'. At this head stamp-verification.py normalises BOTH sides through one helper (_lf: CRLF to LF in _head_text and _wt_text), so the hunk split and changed_source compare line content; _isolated_run writes the test-only copy back in the line ends the throwaway's file already uses (_in_endings_of). The P126.3 claims (CRLF house abort read via the [ \t\r]*$ end, CRLF inline suite split, sr44 quoting) now hold at the head, and the loosening it introduced (an unchanged declared source reported changed) is closed. P126.3 therefore re-judges as matches at this head; its original commit alone still carries the defect, superseded by 2daa337d. I ran the file's selftest once at this head: exit 0, 266/266. Its new si5-si7 build a real git repo per shape (LF blob/CRLF wt, CRLF/CRLF, LF/LF) with autocrlf pinned false and assert exact hunk counts and changed_source True/False, so they would catch the regression the old si6 pinned. P126.15: the interactive step is guarded with !cancelled(), the /tmp/dl legs moved to their own exempt step, and step_exemption_breadth_drift narrows the exemption to a step that reads the named path after a producer; prove-gates gained a red row (sg6) and an allow row (sg5) whose anchors match the code. Residual: finding 1. P126.16: _spellings adds the as-given spelling only when rooted (posix isabs, leading slash or backslash, or a drive); mp15 covers proj/sub and proj-backslash-sub (the 'rel dir' spelling has no slash so it could not have been added before either and is not red-capable). P126.17: sr214 now asserts only its own root_d removed and gone; the cwd-unchanged guarantee is left to the sweep's watched-directory check as the finding asked. The check-committed-pii BASELINE rows added across these tasks excuse prose phrases line by line (keyed by file and line or line hash, each with a reason); they are exact-line, not pattern, so they do not widen the scan. Still open and not touched by these four tasks: P126-R2 (P126.1, tables.css) - the earlier med finding that the bugs-table fix works by margin and u14kt is a CSS-text pin; CI's hostile leg is green at 0aca587b which supports it at CI's font and width only.
